Try putting this in the statement:

```
 /  |       /  |
4---+------3   |
|   5------|---6
|  /       |  /
| /        | /
|/         |/
1----------2
```


Also, remember to format numbers as constants {{}}. It would probably be best to provide a variable [[n]] to be consistent with the statement. 500 seems a bit excessive for the constraint.  I can understand why most of the current cases have the same output, but it would be best to drown that out with many more case pairs that have differing outputs.

I haven't attempted the puzzle yet, these are just my preliminary thoughts, but it seems like it will be fun.
